fichas.h1: Barcelona Premium Walnut Wall Clock by Nomon
fichas.descripcion:
The Nomon Barcelona Premium is a walnut wall clock with a walnut box, walnut and polished brass hands, and a double fiberglass bezel. The bezel rings are the choice between versions.

RINGS AND HANDS

  • Black fiberglass rings or brass fiberglass rings.
  • Walnut box and walnut and polished brass hands in both versions.
  • Optional German UTS.

At Ø35 3/8" x 40 1/2" H x 7” D, this Nomon wall clock needs a large wall; measure first. See more wall clocks.
fichas.descripcion_original:
The Barcelona Premium elevates one of Nomon’s most celebrated models through a more luxurious and sophisticated material palette.
The double fiberglass bezel shines in an elegant polished brass finish—an upgrade that introduces warmth, glamour, and a refined glow to the original minimalist silhouette.
This Premium edition highlights Nomon’s commitment to craftsmanship, innovation, and enduring style.
As part of the Premium Collection, the Barcelona Premium redefines the concept of a designer wall clock, transforming it into a decorative statement piece that seamlessly blends artistic presence with functional precision.

fichas.h1: Dandy Leather Pool Table by Vismara
fichas.descripcion:
The Dandy is a leather pool table by Vismara, designed by Vismara e Bellavista & Piccini. The slate top is covered in Simonis wool and cotton cloth. Made in Italy.

LEATHER AND VENEER

  • Structure and pockets covered in leather.
  • Upper sides in Noce canaletto or Ebony Makassar veneer.
  • Glossy, matt or Soft Touch; cloth in different colors.

SIZES AND VERSIONS

Three sizes, 7, 8 or 9 feet, all 31 5/8" H, up to 115" W x 66 1/2" D. A poker table version comes in Classic or Glitch Color Special Edition. Choosing among pool tables? This Vismara pool table needs room: measure the wall first.
fichas.descripcion_original:
Dandy is the name of this exclusive Italian professional 7ft, 8ft or 9ft Pool Table whose top is in slate covered with cloth. The whole structure is entirely covered in leather, as are the pockets, and the upper part of the sides is in Noce canaletto or Ebony Makassar veneer. The pool table cloth is made of wool and cotton, available in different colors.

This refined game table can be considered a professional table thanks to some specific features. As far as the surface is concerned, the use of slates is essential to grant perfect balance and maximum precision while playing pool. Slates come from Lavagna, a Ligurian city rich in this flat rock. After laying and flattening the slate, the surface is covered with a specific fabric produced by a Belgian company leader in the sector, Simonis.

Its elegant beauty comes from its simplicity: clean lines, essential design and precious materials. Its greatest quality is the perfect balance between form and function. What makes this luxury pool table special, is that it is completely covered in leather, like a tailor made suit. The softness and texture of the leather give elegance and sophistication to this extremely contemporary product. Made in Italy

fichas.h1: Ciclotte Glossy Exercise Bike by Teckell
fichas.descripcion:
The Ciclotte Glossy is an indoor exercise bike by Teckell with a 1 1/8" multilayer glass disc frame and polished stainless steel base. Made in Italy.

TRAINING AND FIT

A 12-magnet flywheel with electronic resistance offers 10 levels. The 6 cm pedal gap protects joints. The carbon fiber or hand-painted handlebar and gel seat adjust for posture; Bluetooth connects to Android/iOS apps.

SPACE AND INCLUDED

The bike measures 43 3/4" W x 19 5/8" D x 43 3/4" H and is for indoor use only. It includes the Teckell Tool Kit and Certificate of Authenticity; the device stand is optional. See more indoor exercise bikes in our cardio equipment selection.
fichas.descripcion_original:
Teckell® Ciclotte® is a revolutionary indoor exercise bike that merges cutting-edge technology with contemporary Italian design. Its signature feature is a 1"1/8 multi-layer circular glass disc—tempered on the outside and hardened within—replacing the traditional frame for a sleek, sculptural aesthetic. The frame and polished stainless steel base flex subtly during use, mimicking real cycling dynamics.

The ergonomic handlebar—available in carbon fiber or hand-painted finish—is height and tilt adjustable, as is the racing-style gel seat, ensuring optimal posture. A compact gearbox and narrow 6 cm pedal distance promote joint-safe performance, while the 12-magnet flywheel system with electronic resistance control enables high-precision training. The system replicates real-road effort, offering 10 fine-tuned resistance levels.

Bluetooth connectivity allows integration with Android/iOS fitness apps for virtual cycling, speed/distance tracking, and entertainment, via an optional black device stand.

A symbol of innovation, the Teckell® Ciclotte® Chrome edition stands out with its transparent low iron glass and polished metal accents—part of Teckell’s Forma Collection. Made in Italy and covered by international patents, it includes the Teckell® Tool Kit, Certificate of Authenticity, and is certified for EU, US, and China markets.

Designed for indoor use.

Made in Italy.

fichas.h1: Tratto Opal Glass Wall Sconce by Kundalini
fichas.descripcion:
The Tratto wall lamp is an opal glass wall sconce by Oliver Schick for Kundalini, with a metal structure and an opal glass diffuser. Made in Italy.

RAISED GRAPHIC EFFECT

The structure creates a raised graphic effect on the wall, with an interplay of light and shadow. It suits residential and contract interiors.

ONE OR IN A COMPOSITION

Hang one on its own, or repeat it along a wall as a composition. At Ø10 5/8" x 11 3/8" H, check the run of wall you want to cover before deciding how many wall lamps you need. See our wall sconces for other options.
fichas.descripcion_original:
The Tratto wall lamp is a luxury lighting element crafted in premium metal and opal glass, designed to bring refined elegance and subtle sophistication to any interior. With its clean and linear profile, it integrates seamlessly into the environment while offering a high-end decorative presence.

Its sleek structure creates a raised graphic effect on the wall, enriching the space with an interplay of light and shadow that feels both modern and timeless. Whether installed individually as a minimalist statement or arranged in a composition for a striking design feature, the Tratto wall lamp adapts with elegance and versatility to any setting.

Perfect for residential and contract interiors, this designer wall sconce combines premium materials, contemporary aesthetics, and functionality in perfect balance. It offers a refined way to illuminate while enhancing the character of the space with discreet yet impactful style.

Made in Italy, the Tratto wall lamp represents the excellence of Italian craftsmanship, uniting luxury, innovation, and timeless design in one sophisticated piece.

fichas.h1: George Rope Weave Outdoor Sofa by Talenti
fichas.descripcion:
George is a two-seater outdoor sofa by Ludovica + Roberto Palomba for Talenti. The stainless steel frame is fully wrapped in a slightly padded rope weave, with generously padded seat and back cushions. Made in Italy.

ROPE AND CUSHIONS

  • Stainless steel structure covered entirely in a padded rope weave.
  • Removable covers on this Talenti sofa are easy to wash and resist atmospheric agents.
  • The Talenti George sofa comes in three color combinations.

TERRACE AND DECK

At 69 5/8" W and 35 7/8" D with a 15 5/8" seat height, it pairs with the low tables and lounge chairs of the same collection. For larger groups, see our outdoor sofas.
fichas.descripcion_original: George is a splendid two seater sofa with an enveloping design and a strong reminiscence of the nautical world. The stainless steel structure is totally covered with a slightly padded rope weave, counterpointed by generously padded seat and back cushions. Available in three elegant color combinations, this exclusive Italian designer sofa features removable covers, easy to wash and resistant to atmospheric agents. Completed by sectionals, low tables, dining tables, chairs and lounge chairs, this luxury Italian furniture collection was created with the aim of combining lightness and comfort in life in the open air, redesigning situations that convey feelings of intimacy and relaxation. Made in Italy.

fichas.descripcion:
Paloma Speakers are active freestanding luxury speakers by Vismara, designed by Studio Boccaccio 432 with a dual tweeter system and a subwoofer built into the cone base.

DRIVERS AND AMPLIFIER

A dome tweeter and a ribbon tweeter, two woofers, and a subwoofer in the base. An integrated amplifier is required to operate them.

CONE BASE FINISH

  • Hand-painted gradient cone base.
  • Lacquered cone base.

fichas.descripcion_original:
Paloma Speakers are designed as a natural extension of Paloma integrated and modular Sound System, conceived to enhance and expand the acoustic performance of the environment with both power and precision.

Available as freestanding elements, Paloma Speakers can be placed according to the scale and requirements of the space, allowing for a fully customizable and high-performance audio environment.

Paloma Speakers integrate a dual tweeter system, featuring both a dome tweeter and a ribbon tweeter, complemented by two woofers and a subwoofer housed in the base.

An integrated amplifier enables the speakers to operate as an active system and is required for their operation.

Paloma speakers are available in two aesthetic versions: one featuring a hand-painted gradient cone base, and one with a lacquered cone base, offering different interpretations of its iconic design.

Moreover, to add more sophistication,it has a stylish vertical tufting on the external part of the backrest. A refined and comfortable seat which shape and silhouettes offer moments of pure relaxation.Made in Italy.

fichas.descripcion:
The Luceplan Mesh ceiling lamp is a 96-LED ceiling light designed by Francisco Gomez Paz, built from a network of flexible cables. Made in Italy.

96 LED POINTS

  • 96 LEDs, each one at a precise intersection of the cables.
  • LED 53W, 2518 lumens, 2700K, CRI 90. Dimmable.

SIZE AND PLACEMENT

At Ø28 3/8" wide and 12 5/8" high, it fits over a dining table or in a living room. The Luceplan lamp is UL approved. For other designs, browse all ceiling lamps.
fichas.descripcion_original:
The Mesh ceiling lamp brings a striking new dimension to the iconic Mesh collection, now presented in a refined ceiling-mounted design featuring 96 LED light points. Its ultra-light, almost transparent structure is composed of a delicate network of flexible cables, where each LED is positioned at precise intersections. This innovative architecture hides the complexity of its technology, allowing the light itself to become the true protagonist. Thanks to advanced electronics, Mesh offers exceptional freedom in lighting control, enabling precise adjustment of light intensity to create the perfect atmosphere. The result is a highly customizable, theatrical illumination that enhances any contemporary interior with sophistication and visual drama. UL Approved (Product build according to the National Electrical Code’s requirements and tested by Underwriters Laboratories). Made in Italy.

Light source: LED 53W 2518lm 2700K CRI 90 Dimmable. UL Approved.
